units.function: HTTP route tests for entering review through confirmation/policy/monitor paths, same-Run confirmation binding, board repair/cancellation/reassignment, and monitored child work.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest/Supertest -> Issue routes -> mocked access, Issue, interaction, approval, heartbeat and activity services with a transaction stub; environment lease cleanup reaches partially real services as a best-effort terminal side effect.
units.keyDataModels: Board or Agent actor and Run; pending request_confirmation interaction and optional reviewInteractionId; execution policy/state; Issue assignment/status; monitor schedule/owner/externalRef; activity receipt and transaction identity.
units.lifecycle: Authorize Issue mutation -> validate an Agent review path -> optionally bind a same-Agent/same-Run confirmation -> transition/update and activity in one transaction -> manage monitor/assignment effects; board actors may repair, cancel or dissolve review; terminal transitions attempt best-effort execution-environment cleanup.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed 17/17; sandboxed 0/17 due solely to prohibited TCP listen. Tests cover stable error details, explicit confirmation ownership, rollback transaction identity, board/Agent distinctions and monitor anti-spoofing. They heavily mock identity/storage and omit concurrent confirmation consumption, idempotency, exact approval content, superseding decisions, active Run cancellation, outbox delivery and cross-tenant matrices. Two passing cases emitted swallowed sandbox-lease cleanup failures.
units.designRationale: Require Agents to point to a real review mechanism before parking work in_review, bind higher-confidence confirmations to their originating Run, and keep operator repair/monitor controls usable.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must convert proposed Agent actions into explicit review/approval requests whose exact subject, evidence, responsible human, Run and eventual decision are atomically linked, while cleanup and Connector control remain observable and recoverable.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT stable disposition codes, typed review paths, explicit same-Run interaction binding, transactional update/audit, monitor actor normalization and secret omission. Require every transition to reference a consumed ReviewRequest with action/evidence digest; replace board repair/cancel/reassign shortcuts with immutable superseding decisions; add CAS/idempotency, durable outbox, active Run cancellation handshake and cleanup reconciliation receipts.
units.responsibilityConflict: The existence of an unbound pending confirmation can authorize in_review without recording which request applied; board actors can bypass or dissolve the review chain without a decision; terminal success can coexist with failed sandbox cleanup. These paths prevent an exact answer to who authorized what and whether execution actually stopped.
evidence: git history: 16 commits from 814cb336766cabd7c5a08fb82849d93e35a7ddaf through 73eb23734f25c570d88665e672f80d740797c632 recorded in read ledger
2026-08-19 sandboxed focused Vitest: 0/17 passed; all failed because TCP listen was prohibited (EPERM)
2026-08-19 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest: 17/17 passed with two swallowed sandbox-lease cleanup warnings
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL responsibility bypass: board repair/cancel/reassignment can bypass or erase review without a superseding decision. HIGH confirmation ambiguity: an unbound pending interaction is sufficient and is absent from the activity receipt. HIGH execution-stop gap: review cancellation does not assert active Run cancellation and terminal cleanup failures are swallowed. HIGH approval-binding gap: confirmation prompt is not bound to exact action/data/evidence/result digests. MEDIUM concurrency gap: no one-time consumption/CAS test. MEDIUM durability gap: no outbox or cleanup reconciliation proof. POSITIVE: explicit same-Run binding, stable codes, transaction identity and monitor anti-spoofing are strong primitives.
